title: August and the Sigil
author: Quentin Nakamura
blurb: Mara Galloway, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
